hedging_delta.evidence: Language slightly more definitive with concrete metrics like 98% efficiency and specific customer wins vs prior's more general commentary.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q3 at $3.17B (+14.6% seq); current guides Q4 at $3.28B (+2.9% seq), a marked deceleration in growth trajectory.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: CapEx plan cut from $2.0-2.3B (prior) to slightly below $2B (current), a downward revision of the same guided metric.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New NXP MEMS acquisition, silicon photonics R&D programs, and second LEO satellite customer are substantive new topics absent in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Prior called out 'strong sequential growth' and 'strength of our product portfolio'; current is more measured, citing results 'in line with expectations.'

demand_language_delta.evidence: Automotive prior grew 14% sequentially with book-to-bill 'below parity'; current grew only 10% sequentially despite book-to-bill above 1, and Industrial sequential growth slowed from 15% to 8%.
